data.title: Get Amped for Season 2: Power Surge — Play Now!
data.meta_title: Get Amped for Season 2: Power Surge — Play Now!
data.content:
Spark a new era in Season 2: Power Surge, now live in War Robots: Frontiers. Play for free with fully charged crossplayon PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S™, Xbox One™, and Windows PC via Steam and MY.GAMES Launcher!

Turn Up The Voltage With A New Titan: Volta 

This live wire Titan is the first quadruped Titan, and it’s as aggressive as it is electrifying. Its traversal capabilities are sure to set Volta apart from other Titans on the battlefield.

Activate its electric weapon, Cascade, and use its special abilities to generate a moving barrier that blocks projectiles and deals damage to enemies who pass through.

Light Up The Battlefield with New War Robots: Loki & Mesa 

Loki

Ignite the grid with a new War Robot designed for fantastic flanks. Loki uses holographic projections to get the drop on the enemy, deploying a copy to confuse its foe before launching an all-out attack with the devastating Halo Weapon.

Grab the Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass (now live) to unlock dozens of adrenaline-pumping rewards, including exclusive cosmetics, battle gear, and Loki! You can also unlock Loki via Daily Deals.

Mesa

Mesa’s barrier-deploying abilities shield itself and its allies, making it a dependable defender for tough fights. Buff allies and weaken enemies with this War Robot’s biotech drone to turn the tide of battle, and hit hard with its new Locust Weapon. 

Unlock Mesa through the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass and/or Daily Deals (coming July 29). 

Powerslide Into A New Game Mode: Spearhead

Join the fray as two teams fight over randomly spawning Warp Probes to stabilize Warp in the region. Locate and capture them first to earn Points! 

Hit the Points cap, stay ahead, or eliminate all enemies to win in this electric new Game Mode.

Recruit A Sparky New Hero Pilot: Sora Sing

Recruit Sora Sing as your War Robot’s new Pilot. This femme fatale may not have won the trust of her fellow Pilots yet, but she’s eager to pull out all the stops in battle with her fast reload speed and boosted damage skills. 

Sora Sing will be available in the Store.

Charge Up With Launch Events

Celebrate the current events of Season 2 with launch activities! 

  • New Credit Offers: Idy Demerost (Hero Pilot) and Fury (War Robot) with Pulsar Weapons will be available to buy for Credits.
  • Battle Bonus Event (June 17 - July 1): Log in and play one battle each day to receive cosmetic rewards.
  • Intel Catch-Up (June 17 - July 15): A special event for returning and new players to help get your Builds up to scratch.
  • Pilot XP Event (June 24): Put your Pilots through a rigorous boot camp to bring out their best in battle.
  • Titan Weapon Coming to Daily Deals (starting July 1): The Jigsaw Weapon for Grim will come to Daily Deals starting July 1 for a limited time.
  • Twitch Drops (June 17 - July 1): Tune in to War Robots: Frontiers Content Creators on Twitch to earn rewards including Modules!

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

PlayStation®5│PlayStation®4│ Xbox Series X|S™ │Xbox One™

Steam │ MY.GAMES Launcher

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels, and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit and Discord for all the latest news and updates.
